title: How to Project Customer Retention
units: Percent of original cohort surviving; period is one YEAR, not one month
provenance: Manually transcribed numerical facts, checked against the rendered original table. The source describes an unspecified subscription-type business and refers to Berry and Linoff (2004).
limitations: Two published cohorts with percentages rounded to 0.1 percentage point; customer counts and intervention history are unavailable. This is not our startup dataset, not a representative benchmark of all subscription businesses, and not a causal price experiment.
